reason: The unfired blanks need heat to become a firm floor material, and the solar heating bay appears suited to firing them.
expectation: The solar heat will fire the blanks into stronger floor pieces.

effect: The blanks are now ceramic blocks suitable for non-pressure paving, so they can be used to prepare the growing bay floor.
reaction: The distinction between paving and pressure-bearing material is reassuringly clear.
reason: The blocks appear intended to make the cleared growing bay safe for the liner.
expectation: The blocks will form a paved floor for the pressure liner.

effect: The blocks made a level floor, but their edges still need padding before the liner can be installed.
reaction: The remaining liner protection is clear from the result.
reason: Insulation felt is a plausible padding layer for the hard block edges.
expectation: The felt will cushion the floor for the pressure liner.

effect: The felt needed a fabric cover first; the resulting padded underlay can now protect the liner from the floor.
reaction: The automatic combination clarified the missing preparation.
reason: The padded underlay is ready to cover the unpadded cavern floor.
expectation: The underlay will cushion the ceramic floor for the pressure envelope.

effect: The protected floor is ready for the pressure envelope, and the next goal is an inhabited, illuminated room.
reaction: The layered floor preparation now has a clear purpose.
reason: The folded pressure envelope should be installed on the protected floor before the room can be inhabited.
expectation: The envelope will be laid out on the cushioned floor, ready for pressurization.

effect: The envelope is installed and sealed; the room still needs breathable gas and lighting.
reaction: The distinction between imported pressure seals and local structural support is clear.
reason: The sealed room needs breathing gas before it can be inhabited.
expectation: The gas supply will pressurize the room with breathable air.

alternatives.reason: The lights are also needed, but pressurizing the room seems a useful next step.

effect: The room is pressurized and has passed its leak check; lighting remains to complete the goal.
reaction: The first walk inside makes the enclosure feel tangible.
reason: The grow-light rails should provide the remaining illumination.
expectation: The rails will be installed to illuminate the growing room.

effect: The light rails completed the growing room, with circulation and heating supplied through its service spine; all chapter goals are complete.
reaction: The explanation that the array was sized for the lights makes the finished room feel more credible.

mostWorthwhile.text: Preparing the layered floor was worthwhile: the game explained how level ceramic blocks carry the load while a padded underlay protects the pressure skin.

leastWorthwhile.text: Installing the light rails was straightforward and less interesting as a decision, although it completed the room.

surprise.text: I expected the felt to go straight onto the floor, but it first needed a clean fabric cover; the compatibility feedback automatically made the underlay.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt wholly arbitrary, though the fabric-cover requirement was not obvious to me until the failed pairing revealed it.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how the growing room is used; the practical explanations and the first walk inside made its construction engaging.
